observations: The shared root is genuinely reused as a learned unary property and the ca construction introduces a second written role. This is a compositional source-language lesson, unlike a table that merely names unrelated whole-form outputs.

In an ordinary model of the stipulated meanings, an already warm jug can stay warm with no transition, and a jug can become warm without Mara causing the transition. These distinguish state, change and causation. They are semantic examples, not measurements or observations of a manuscript event.

Mara failing to cause a change is consistent with a different cause making it occur. Successful transition to not-warm does not imply cold; not-empty does not imply full. Outer not and internal anti therefore remain distinct.

Adjacent identical names can fill the two independently written roles if the declared domain permits self-causation. This is not repeated application of be/ca to their own event output; it does not rescue GDT1046.
A learned property root still costs its ordinary meaning, valency and appropriate entity domain. Literal name spelling does not resolve homonymy or silently identify physical batches.
